title: Vietnamese-Style Turmeric Cod with Dill and Rice Noodles
summary: A light, aromatic dinner inspired by Vietnamese cha ca, with turmeric-marinated cod, plenty of dill, spring onion and soft rice noodles. It is fresh, savoury and gently spiced, ideal for a quick pescatarian weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: cod fillets, cut into large chunks
spring onions, cut into 4 cm lengths

steps: Put the cod in a bowl with the turmeric, ground ginger, grated garlic, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, a pinch of salt and black pepper. Turn gently to coat, then leave to marinate for 15 minutes while you prepare the noodles and vegetables.
Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the packet instructions until just tender. Drain, rinse briefly under warm water to stop them sticking, and divide between two bowls.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the marinated cod pieces in a single layer and cook for 2–3 minutes until golden at the edges.
Carefully turn the cod and cook for another 2 minutes, until opaque and just flaking. Avoid moving it too much so the pieces stay intact.
Add the spring onions and most of the dill to the pan. Toss very gently for 30–60 seconds, just until the spring onions soften slightly and the dill wilts and becomes fragrant.
Spoon the turmeric cod, dill and spring onions over the rice noodles. Serve with sliced cucumber, chopped peanuts, sliced chilli and the remaining fresh dill on top.
